name: Tetris Live
description: Real Tetris, played live by an AI on the watch: seven materials of block fall, rotate and lock, rows dissolve, the stack drops, and a new game starts when it tops out. The time is spelled in oak and steel blocks on concrete.

steps.script: const n = project.elements.length; ['Hour','Colon','Minute'].forEach((nm,i)=>{ project.elements[n-3+i].name = nm + ' Aod'; }); return 1
